user.title: Set up BlueSight
user.description: BlueSight reads your existing Bluetooth proxies and needs no configuration to start. Storm and poll settings can be tuned later in the integration's options.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of BlueSight is allowed. There is one Bluetooth stack per Home Assistant.

init.title: BlueSight options
init.description: Tune the pairing-storm window, the poll backstop, and the proxy-health thresholds.

data_description.storm_window_s: Sliding window over which repeated connection failures are counted.
data_description.storm_threshold: Number of failures within the window that raises a pairing-storm incident.
data_description.poll_interval_s: How often the slot snapshot is refreshed as a backstop to push updates.
data_description.stalled_threshold_s: How long a proxy can go without seeing any Bluetooth advertisement before it is flagged as stalled.
data_description.reboot_window_s: Sliding window over which proxy reboots are counted.
data_description.reboot_threshold: Number of reboots within the window that raises a flapping-proxy incident.
data_description.offline_grace_s: How long a proxy may be missing before it is reported offline. A proxy drops off the bus for a while on every OTA update; set to 0 to report the very first missing snapshot.
data_description.idle_threshold_s: How long a held GATT connection may go without traffic before the slot is reported as stuck. Only proxies running the BlueSight ESPHome component measure this, and only devices Home Assistant does not otherwise know are judged by it. Set it above the quietest legitimate device you own: a sensor that only notifies on change can hold a perfectly healthy connection in silence for minutes, and a lower value reports it as a ghost slot. A higher value leaves a genuinely stuck slot unreported for longer.

forget_proxy.name: Forget proxy
forget_proxy.description: Stop tracking a proxy, clearing any open 'proxy offline' incident. Use it after retiring or replacing a proxy — otherwise it stays remembered and keeps alerting as offline.

source.name: Source
source.description: MAC address of the proxy to forget, as shown on its BlueSight device.
